_about: Optics receipt for one camera, format_version 1. Make one per camera whose optics source is operator,
for example ~/gpo-setup/cam_a-optics.json and ~/gpo-setup/cam_b-optics.json, and fill it from that camera's own readout.
Over VISCA, observe.py optics inquire --camera-id cam_a ... --out ~/gpo-setup/cam_a-optics.json --recorded-by NAME writes the read-back values; fill lens_attachment afterwards.
Check it with: tools/cad-venv/bin/python tools/gun-positioner-observation/observe.py optics check ~/gpo-setup/cam_a-optics.json --camera-id cam_a
Measurement is refused unless focus_mode is manual, exposure_mode is manual and tracking is off, and once the receipt is older than receipt_max_age_hours in cameras.json.
Write each value as the camera displays it or VISCA reads it back; write not_available for a value the camera does not show.
Never copy values from another camera, another day or this example. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
camera_id: FILL_ME: cam_a or cam_b, as in cameras.json
recorded_at: FILL_ME: when the settings were read, ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-05T09:30:00-05:00
exposure_mode: FILL_ME: manual, full_auto, shutter_priority, iris_priority or bright
zoom: FILL_ME: zoom as displayed or read back, or not_available
focus: FILL_ME: focus position as displayed or read back, or not_available
shutter: FILL_ME: shutter as displayed (e.g. a 1/250 setting) or read back, or not_available
iris: FILL_ME: iris as displayed or read back, or not_available
gain: FILL_ME: gain or gain limit as displayed or read back, or not_available
white_balance: FILL_ME: white balance as displayed or read back, or not_available
lens_attachment: FILL_ME: attached close-up lens, e.g. Raynox DCR-250, or none
